prompt: The test suite in test/ fails. Find and fix the bugs in the inventory package so that all tests pass. Do not change the tests.
solution: sed -i.bak 's/int(float(price) \* 100)/round(float(price) * 100)/' inventory/io.py && sed -i.bak 's/items\[1:\]/items/' inventory/report.py && rm inventory/*.bak
